stats.heading: Progress

streak.label: Streak
streak.longest: Longest: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.detail: {days} of {total, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} studied

heatmap.heading: Activity
heatmap.summary: {label}: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, at most {max, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} a day

forecast.heading: Forecast
forecast.intro: Cards due in the next 30 days.

states.heading: Memory states
states.meaning: Where your cards are: new → learning → young → mature (21+ day interval).

success.heading: Success rate
success.meaning: How many of your answers were right; the thin line is your target recall.

trend.heading: Progress
trend.meaning: Your reviews per week or month.

hours.heading: Best hours
hours.intro: Success rate by hour of the day.

times.heading: Answer times
times.meaning: How long you take to answer a card.

memory.heading: Stability and difficulty
memory.meaning: Stability: days until recall drops to 90%. Difficulty: 1 (easy) – 10 (hard).

breakdown.heading: By classification
breakdown.intro: Compare progress across the values of a classification.

leeches.heading: Cards you keep struggling with
leeches.count: {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} you got wrong at least {threshold, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}

leeches.intro: Cards you got wrong again and again; rewrite or set them aside.

report.heading: Deck report cards
report.intro: How far along each deck is.

stats.empty: No reviews in this period yet.
stats.subtitle: Three questions, three short answers. More detail at the bottom, under “More”.
stats.empty_hint: Study a few cards and your activity shows up here.

more.heading: Habits and memory
more.meaning: When you remember best, how fast you answer, how solid your memory is.

today.heading: How am I doing today?
today.intro: What you answered today, next to yesterday, and your goal.

pace.not_started_ref: You haven't studied today yet; yesterday you answered {ref} cards.

pace.behind_week: Behind your 7-day average: ~{ref} cards a day, {n} so far today.

ahead.heading: What's ahead?
ahead.intro: Cards coming up for review in the next days. Overdue cards count for today.
ahead.plan: How many new words a day?

struggles.heading: What am I struggling with?
struggles.intro: Words you got wrong recently, most misses first. Practice and tests included.

struggles.none: No wrong answers in the last {n} days.
struggles.suspend: Set aside (don't ask until you bring it back)
struggles.nothing: Nothing to study (they may all be set aside).
struggles.started: Practice session ready: “Continue” on the Study screen.

details.heading: Details
details.intro: Your history and memory for the selected range and deck.

summary.heading: Range summary
summary.meaning: Streak, reviews, time and true recall in the selected range.

today.heading: What did I do today?
today.say: Today you studied {n, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} and knew {correct}.
today.chart: Last 7 days, words studied per day
today.no_hard: No word gave you trouble today.

growing.heading: Am I getting better?
growing.learning: You are learning {n} more, and {fresh} are waiting; as they settle, this number grows.
growing.unassigned: {n, plural, one {# note has} other {# notes have}} no language, so they are not counted. Pick their language in Settings › Words.
growing.meaning: Known = a word you still remember after {days} days, or marked “I already know this”.
growing.empty: As you add and study words, the ones you know are counted here.
growing.cards_sub: Settled: a card whose interval is over three weeks.

tomorrow.heading: What’s coming tomorrow?
tomorrow.say: Tomorrow {n} words are due for review.
tomorrow.none_sub: As you study, how many words come up on which day shows here.
tomorrow.peak_tomorrow: Tomorrow is the busiest day this week.
tomorrow.meaning: New words are not included in this number.

more_toggle.label: More
more_toggle.hint: Study calendar, recall rate, word stages, words you keep forgetting and more charts. Each says what it shows.

forecast30.heading: Next 30 days
forecast30.meaning: How many words come up on each day. Overdue ones count for today; new words are not included.

repair.title: “{term}”: why do you keep forgetting it?
repair.intro: Your last wrong answers and ways to fix the card. Each fix can be undone in one step.
repair.lapses: {n, plural, one {You forgot this word # time.} other {You forgot this word # times.}}
repair.typed_off: Typed answers are not kept (Settings › Study). Turn it on and the next wrong ones show here.
repair.confusables: This word has other meanings too: {list}
repair.none: No clear fix for this card. Reread its sentence or set it aside for a while.
repair.small_sample: Few answers so far; the difference says little yet.
repair.undo: Every fix can be undone: Ctrl+Z.

kind.move_meaning: Move the other meaning to its own card

why.better_example: Another scene where you saw this word looks more helpful.
why.senses_not_accepted: The meaning has several parts; each alone is not accepted yet.
why.also_correct_not_accepted: The suggested meaning lists other right answers that are not accepted yet.
why.mixed_meanings: You also caught this word with another meaning; the card mixes the two.
why.fresh_angle: Nothing specific found; a different wording may help.

stats.adv_note: Filters, stability/difficulty charts and stats by classification are under Advanced (Settings).

planning.heading: Planning

balance.heading: Load balancing and easy days
balance.meaning: Moves reviews to the least busy of equally good days; easy days get fewer reviews.

exams.intro: Cards of an exam are reviewed again shortly before it.
exams.name: Name
exams.days_left: in {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
exams.none_hint: Add one below and its cards come back just before the day.

optimizer.done: Saved {n, plural, one {# parameter} other {# parameters}} into the preset (undoable).

workload.basis: Based on {n} review cards and {new} new cards per day.

pace.intro: See how much you'll study in the coming weeks for each number of new cards a day.

pace.sentence: At this pace, in {weeks} weeks: ~{cards} cards and ~{min} min a day.
pace.sentence_days: At this pace, in {days} days: ~{cards} cards and ~{min} min a day.
pace.new_done: Your {n} unstarted new cards run out on {date}.
pace.new_none: No unstarted new cards: the load is reviews only.
pace.new_later: {n} new cards are waiting; at this pace they last beyond this view.
pace.new_zero: 0 new cards a day: reviews only, {n} new cards keep waiting.

pace.exam_ok: {days} days to the exam: you'll have started every new card before it.
pace.exam_need: To start them all, you need {n} new cards a day.
pace.exam_week: The week before the exam: ~{cards} cards and ~{min} min a day.
pace.time_measured: Minutes use your average of {s} s per card over the last 30 days.
pace.time_default: No timing yet; {s} s per card assumed.
